proposals.title: 2026 Operating Budget
proposals.body: Approve a CHF 48,000 budget allocated across Welfare (CHF 18k), Events (CHF 12k), Admin (CHF 8k), Tooling (CHF 6k), and Contingency (CHF 4k).

proposals.title: Extend Chair Term to 2 years
proposals.body: Move from 1-year to 2-year chair terms to improve continuity. Existing terms grandfathered.

proposals.title: Archive Youth Starter Circle
proposals.body: Low participation. Proposal to archive after the current cycle completes; current members will be invited to Welfare Booster.

candidates.name: Amara Ofori
candidates.pitch: Three years as Treasurer. Clean audits. Plans to onboard predictive analytics from Section 8 to anticipate cash needs.

candidates.name: Mariam Rahimi
candidates.pitch: Auditor for two years. Will modernise the welfare approval workflow and tighten reconciliation.

candidates.name: Ngozi Okafor
candidates.pitch: Organiser background. Will push for English/French parity on all communications.
